lines.en: Did the doctors find out how the woman died?
lines.cn: 医生们查明这名妇女的死因了吗？

lines.en: The mummy of an Egyptian woman who died in 800 B.C. has just had an operation.
lines.cn: 这位埃及女性的木乃伊（她死于公元前800年）刚刚接受了一次手术。

lines.en: The mummy is that of Shepenmut who was once a singer in the Temple of Thebes.
lines.cn: 这具木乃伊属于谢彭穆特（Shepenmut），她曾经是底比斯神庙中的一名歌手。

lines.en: As there were strange marks on the X-ray plates taken of the mummy,
lines.cn: 由于在拍摄木乃伊的X光片上发现了奇怪的痕迹，

lines.en: doctors have been trying to find out whether the woman died of a rare disease.
lines.cn: 医生们一直在试图确定这名女性是否死于一种罕见的疾病。

lines.en: The only way to do this was to operate.
lines.cn: 唯一可行的办法就是立即采取行动（或：开始执行这项任务）。

lines.en: The operation, which lasted for over four hours,
lines.cn: 这次手术持续了四个多小时。

lines.en: proved to be very difficult because of the hard resin which covered the skin.
lines.cn: 由于皮肤上覆盖着一层坚硬的树脂，这被证明是非常困难的（即：处理这个问题的过程非常复杂或具有挑战性）。

lines.en: The doctors removed a section of the mummy and sent it to a laboratory.
lines.cn: 医生们切下了木乃伊的一部分组织，并将其送到了实验室进行检测。

lines.en: They also found something which the X-ray plates did not show: a small wax figure of the god Duamutef.
lines.cn: 他们还发现了一些X光片未能显示的东西：一个微小的、用蜡制成的杜阿穆特夫神像。

lines.en: This god which has the head of a cow was normally placed inside a mummy.
lines.cn: 这个长着牛头的神像通常被放置在木乃伊的体内。

lines.en: The doctors have not yet decided how the woman died.
lines.cn: 医生们尚未确定这名妇女的死因。

lines.en: They feared that the mummy would fall to pieces when they cut it open,
lines.cn: 他们担心在打开木乃伊时，木乃伊会碎成碎片。

lines.en: but fortunately this has not happened.
lines.cn: 但幸运的是，这种情况并没有发生。

lines.en: The mummy successfully survived the operation.
lines.cn: 这具木乃伊成功度过了手术。
